about_the_game:
Astromattech is a relentless twin-stick bullet hell game for 1-4 players, set across a vast array of procedurally generated worlds, inspired by iconic sci-fi universes. Forge and evolve a powerful arsenal of weapons and companions as you battle fierce enemies, all in your quest to become the most dominant droid in the galaxy.

Embark on an intergalactic adventure, journeying to far-flung planets, attacking enemy spaceships and dismantling enemy stations. Astromattech immerses you in a galaxy full of diverse environments, each with its own unique foes, resources and hidden secrets to be uncovered. Navigate the stars, charting unknown territories as a daring pioneer of the cosmos.

Salvage parts from your vanquished enemies, repurpose their scraps and craft devastating weaponry and robots to aid in your destructive mission of universal conquest.

Design and build your own fortress, an awe-inspiring stronghold that's filled with cutting-edge machinery and loyal minions that will heed your every command.

  • Relax and play solo or team up with up to three friends to experience a thrilling, wave-based survival mode. Dynamic enemies evolve with increasing difficulty and variety, keeping you on your toes through every encounter

  • Dive into an expansive crafting system that allows you to customize your experience to match your preferred playstyle. Whether you favour speed, power or resilience, there's an approach for every type of player.

  • Prepare for epic boss battles that will push even the most advanced droids to their limits, testing your skills and strategy to the fullest.

  • Take advantage of a wide range of upgrades and perks to enhance your abilities. Boost your health, increase your movement speed, reduce power consumption and more to give you the edge in the heat of battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10(64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible sound card

short_description: Astromattech is a high-octane space adventure where you raid enemy ships, planets, and bases to collect loot. Use resources to upgrade your abilities and build a mighty robot army. Strategize, enhance, and conquer the galaxy in your quest for ultimate dominance!
